\sphinxAtStartPar
FastAPI startup handler that initializes camera capture threads and loads config.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This startup event reads NVR credentials from environment variables, retrieves
basic ONVIF device information, discovers available camera channels, loads
per\sphinxhyphen{}channel frame\sphinxhyphen{}intervals from FRAME\_CONFIG\_FILE (falls back to \sphinxtitleref{g\_frame\_interval}),
creates manual capture \sphinxtitleref{threading.Event} flags for each channel, and spawns a
daemon thread that runs \sphinxtitleref{capture\_camera} for each discovered channel.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Globals modified:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
manual\_capture\_flags (dict{[}str, threading.Event{]}): Mapping of channel \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} Event used to trigger manual captures.
camera\_frame\_intervals (dict{[}str, int{]}): Mapping of channel \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} frames\sphinxhyphen{}between\sphinxhyphen{}captures.

\sphinxlineitem{Behavior:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calls \sphinxtitleref{onvifCameraInfo} and \sphinxtitleref{getCameraChannels} (network/ONVIF IO).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
May create/modify FRAME\_CONFIG\_FILE\sphinxhyphen{}backed data in memory.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Starts one daemon thread per channel (threads call \sphinxtitleref{capture\_camera}).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Logs info, warnings, and errors to \sphinxtitleref{logger}.

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Raises}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{ValueError}} \textendash{} If NVR\_USERNAME or NVR\_PASSWORD environment variables are not set.

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
None

\end{description}\end{quote}

\end{fulllineitems}

\subsubsection{src.model\_training.trainer module}
\label{\detokenize{modules/src.model_training.trainer:module-src.model_training.trainer}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.model_training.trainer:src-model-training-trainer-module}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.model_training.trainer::doc}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!src.model\_training.trainer@\spxentry{src.model\_training.trainer}}\index{src.model\_training.trainer@\spxentry{src.model\_training.trainer}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pig Sorting YOLO Training API

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module provides FastAPI endpoints and helper functions for training and managing Ultralytics YOLO models.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Key Features:
\sphinxhyphen{} Train YOLO models using a provided dataset (.yaml or .zip format) with configurable hyperparameters.
\sphinxhyphen{} Stream training progress in real\sphinxhyphen{}time via Server\sphinxhyphen{}Sent Events (SSE).
\sphinxhyphen{} Export trained models to ONNX format and validate on the dataset.
\sphinxhyphen{} Dynamically handle datasets: unzip archives, locate .yaml configuration files.
\sphinxhyphen{} GPU support with logging of device and CUDA availability.
\sphinxhyphen{} Threaded training to prevent blocking the API server.
\sphinxhyphen{} Utility endpoints for retrieving available datasets and projects.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Endpoints:
\sphinxhyphen{} /training/trainer: Synchronous training, returns trained model path and validation metrics.
\sphinxhyphen{} /training/stream: Asynchronous training with real\sphinxhyphen{}time progress updates.
\sphinxhyphen{} /training/datasets: List all available datasets and projects.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Dependencies:
\sphinxhyphen{} ultralytics, torch, fastapi, logging, asyncio, threading, queue, zipfile, os, json

\sphinxAtStartPar
Remove and return an item from the queue.

\sphinxAtStartPar
If optional args ‘block’ is true and ‘timeout’ is None (the default),
block if necessary until an item is available. If ‘timeout’ is
a non\sphinxhyphen{}negative number, it blocks at most ‘timeout’ seconds and raises
the Empty exception if no item was available within that time.
Otherwise (‘block’ is false), return an item if one is immediately
available, else raise the Empty exception (‘timeout’ is ignored
in that case).

\end{fulllineitems}

{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{join}}}
{}
{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Blocks until all items in the Queue have been gotten and processed.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The count of unfinished tasks goes up whenever an item is added to the
queue. The count goes down whenever a consumer thread calls task\_done()
to indicate the item was retrieved and all work on it is complete.

\sphinxAtStartPar
When the count of unfinished tasks drops to zero, join() unblocks.

\end{fulllineitems}

{}
{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Indicate that a formerly enqueued task is complete.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Used by Queue consumer threads.  For each get() used to fetch a task,
a subsequent call to task\_done() tells the queue that the processing
on the task is complete.

\sphinxAtStartPar
If a join() is currently blocking, it will resume when all items
have been processed (meaning that a task\_done() call was received
for every item that had been put() into the queue).

\sphinxAtStartPar
Raises a ValueError if called more times than there were items
placed in the queue.

\end{fulllineitems}


\end{fulllineitems}

\subsubsection{src.pig\_sorting\_api.client module}
\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.client:module-src.pig_sorting_api.client}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.client:src-pig-sorting-api-client-module}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.client::doc}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!src.pig\_sorting\_api.client@\spxentry{src.pig\_sorting\_api.client}}\index{src.pig\_sorting\_api.client@\spxentry{src.pig\_sorting\_api.client}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Asynchronous MongoDB client module using Motor.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module sets up an asynchronous connection to a MongoDB instance using
credentials from environment variables and exposes:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxtitleref{client}: The AsyncIOMotorClient instance connected to the MongoDB server.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxtitleref{db}: The \sphinxtitleref{visionPipe} database.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxtitleref{db\_result}: The \sphinxtitleref{metaData} collection within the \sphinxtitleref{visionPipe} database.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Environment variables required:
\sphinxhyphen{} MONGO\_INITDB\_ROOT\_USERNAME
\sphinxhyphen{} MONGO\_INITDB\_ROOT\_PASSWORD
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Usage:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
from client\_async import db\_result

\sphinxAtStartPar
\# Example asynchronous query
result = await db\_result.find\_one(\{“some\_field”: “value”\})

\end{description}

\sphinxstepscope


\subsubsection{src.pig\_sorting\_api.main module}
\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.main:module-src.pig_sorting_api.main}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.main:src-pig-sorting-api-main-module}}\label{\detokenize{modules/src.pig_sorting_api.main::doc}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!src.pig\_sorting\_api.main@\spxentry{src.pig\_sorting\_api.main}}\index{src.pig\_sorting\_api.main@\spxentry{src.pig\_sorting\_api.main}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
FastAPI API for meat evaluation and image processing pipeline.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module provides:
\sphinxhyphen{} Asynchronous MongoDB integration using Motor.
\sphinxhyphen{} Endpoints for retrieving metadata and images.
\sphinxhyphen{} Endpoints for triggering model training and chain predictions.
\sphinxhyphen{} A MongoDB watcher to automatically process newly inserted images.
\sphinxhyphen{} Utilities to convert images to base64, save annotated predictions, and log results.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Endpoints include:
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/mongoData          : Fetch all metadata from MongoDB.
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/images/            : Fetch images between given timestamps.
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/training/trainer   : Trigger model training.
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/training/stream\_trainer : Stream training logs from GPU container.
\sphinxhyphen{} /chain\_predict             : Forward chain prediction requests to model\sphinxhyphen{}deploy.
\sphinxhyphen{} /save\_prediction           : Save annotated prediction results to MongoDB.
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/collector/capture  : Trigger manual capture of images.
\sphinxhyphen{} /api/v1/collector/frame\_interval : Set camera frame interval.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Dependencies:
\sphinxhyphen{} FastAPI
\sphinxhyphen{} Motor (Async MongoDB client)
\sphinxhyphen{} httpx (Async HTTP requests)
\sphinxhyphen{} PIL, OpenCV, NumPy
\sphinxhyphen{} pymongo, bson
